title: IT60109: Cluster And Grid Computing
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: NoneIntroduction to high performance computing, basic
definitions: cluster, grid, meta-computing, middleware etc., examples of
representative applications. Programming models: shared memory, message
passing, peer-to-peer, broker-based. Introduction to PVM and MPI. Architecture
of cluster-based systems. Issues in cluster design: performance, single-systemimage, fault tolerance, manageability, programmability, load balancing,
security, storage. Architecture of Grid systems. Grid security infrastructure.
Examples of Grids: Globus etc.
